avis.titre: Brightens and evens texture and tone
avis.texte: I'm not a reviewer but I had to share how great this product is. I've had two bouts (each 6 months-a year) of chronic cystic acne all over my face but especially on the sides of my cheeks. No skincare could treat the acne itself and spironolactone had to nip it in the bud, but my skincare did amazing work at repairing the damage and scarring left by the acne. However, I had lingering pitting and discoloration on the sides of my face that I just figured were going to be there for life. I upgraded from the retinaldehyde 5% to the 10% and at the same time started using this vitamin c serum. I have noticed true difference in my scarring and discoloration, and my skin tone is more even and bright than it has been in a long time. The vit c is hydrating even for my dry skin, and I use it every morning. I will be repurchasing in the jumbo size.

Skin Type: Dry, Sensitive Age: 40s I've been using this vitamin C cream from Naturium consistently, and it's become an easy staple in my routine. What stood out to me right away was how comfortable it feels on my skin—no stinging, no irritation, and no heaviness, which can be hard to find with vitamin C products when you have dry, sensitive skin. I like that this is a cream formula rather than a watery serum. It hydrates while still giving my skin a brighter, more even look over time, and it layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen. I also appreciate that it fits into a simple routine without feeling overcomplicated or aggressive. This isn't a product that promises overnight results, but with consistent use my skin looks healthier and more balanced. If you're looking for a vitamin C that supports skin health long‑term and plays well with sensitive skin, this is worth trying.

I started using a VitC serum years ago, and I loved how it worked, but it went bad quickly and felt a bit tacky on my skin, so I stopped using it. I recently got back into skincare and started my research anew. This stable formula is excellent: it has a lovely texture that isn't greasy and melts into my face, layering well with my moisturizer & SPF. I don't wear makeup, so I can't speak as to how it sits underneath. I use one pump every morning. The only caveat is that the form of VitC chosen for it's stability also means it's not as potent as others you might find. However, as someone who alternates days between actives on aging, dry, sensitive skin, I'll exchange speed of results for a milder, more stable, formula - just be consistent!
